traps.title: UPSC Common Exam Traps
items: Confusing Ashmaka as the only Mahajanapada in South India; verify locations carefully.
Assuming all Mahajanapadas were monarchies; remember Vrijji and Malla were Gana-Sanghas (Republics).
Overlooking that Puranas and Buddhist texts (Anguttara Nikaya) list different versions of the 16 states.

sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Centered in the Gangetic Plains.
  • Iron-rich regions fueled warfare.
  • Strategic river junctions (Patliputra).

Personalities

  • Bimbisara & Ajatashatru (Magadha)
  • Prasenajit (Kosala)
  • Udayana (Vatsa)

Structure of the Mahajanapadas

  • Political Evolution:
    • Monarchies vs. Gana-Sanghas.
    • Transition from tribal Janas to territorial Mahajanapadas.
  • Economic Factors:
    • Use of Punch Marked Coins (PMCs).
    • Second Urbanization: Rise of towns like Shravasti, Vaishali.
